notice: Project-authored condensed descriptors for every source dimension and score point. Not a verbatim official rubric or validated scoring instrument.

organization_purpose.4: Clear sustained claim; purposeful structure, varied links, effective opening and ending, logical progression. For grades 7+, opposing arguments are clearly acknowledged or addressed.
organization_purpose.3: Evident claim; coherent structure, adequate links, opening and ending, with minor lapses. For grades 7+, opposing arguments are adequately acknowledged or addressed.
organization_purpose.2: Uneven claim; inconsistent structure and links, weak opening or ending, uneven progression. For grades 7+, opposing arguments may be confusing or unacknowledged.
organization_purpose.1: Unclear claim; little structure, missing links or boundaries, confusing order or distracting ideas. For grades 7+, opposing arguments may be unacknowledged.

evidence_elaboration.4: Specific relevant source support, clear attribution and convincing development; varied elaboration, precise vocabulary and effective style.
evidence_elaboration.3: Relevant integrated source support and attribution; adequate elaboration, suitable vocabulary and style.
evidence_elaboration.2: Weak or repetitive source support and attribution; uneven elaboration, summary-heavy development and imprecise language.
evidence_elaboration.1: Minimal, misused or mostly copied source material; little attribution, analysis or effective language.

conventions.2: Adequate control of sentence construction, punctuation, capitalization, grammar and spelling.
conventions.1: Partial control; correct conventions are limited.
conventions.0: Little control; correct conventions are infrequent.

scope_notes: Judge convention errors by variety, severity and density; weigh basic errors more heavily.
Opposing views begin at grade 7. Apply the selected grade standards to their expected treatment; grade 6 does not require counterarguments.
total_policy: Display-only unweighted sum; no cross-provider score conversion or proficiency decision.
not_scorable_policy: Source NS reasons; project policy withholds all dimensions and total for any NS. Off-purpose is NS in the first two source dimensions, not the conventions column.
